Usage:
  iris [flags]
  iris [command]

Available Commands:
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  config      manage iris configuration
  crash-log   manage iris crash logs
  help        Help about any command
  init        Generate the autostart script for your shell
  setup       Automatically setup iris shell integration and install binary
  uninstall   Uninstall Iris and remove shell integrations
  update      Update Iris to the latest release
  version     Print the current Iris version

Flags:
  -d, --debug          enable debug logging to iris.log
  -h, --help           help for iris
  -s, --shell string   shell to use (bash, zsh, fish)

Use "iris [command] --help" for more information about a command.
